user_request: 카페의 각진 물체를 부드럽게 하고, 모든 요소에 수채화 감성을 일관되게 적용한다.
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / stylized-concept.
Asset type: a design proposal board for the existing Korean first-person 3D writing cafe "쓰는 인간". This is a proposed watercolor art direction, NOT an actual app screenshot.
Input image 1 is the layout and spatial identity reference of the current implementation. Preserve the recognizable arrangement: tall glazed garden windows on the left, warm walnut and oak long communal table with chairs in the center, a small arched quiet writing alcove in the rear left, coffee counter in the rear center, recommended-book shelving on the right, matted botanical artwork on the plaster wall. Preserve wide walkways and the widened garden sliding doorway. Keep eye-level first-person perspective and navigable 3D depth. No people or avatars.
Primary request: transform the cafe's harsh angular low-poly appearance into a cohesive hand-painted watercolor 3D space. Every object should share the same quiet watercolor sensibility: furniture, cushions, lamps, cups, notebook, pencil, frames, plaster, stone floor, garden plants and pond. Do NOT simply blur the original image or put a watercolor filter over sharp cubes.
Shape language: gently rounded table edges, subtly rounded chair seats and curved wood chair backs, softly curved ceramic mug and vase, smooth bell-shaped pendant shades, softened frame profiles. Believable coherent construction and support, restrained handcrafted irregularity, no faceted polygon steps.
Surface language: translucent watercolor pigment washes, paper-grain granulation integrated into object materials, a few delicate broken warm-gray pencil lines, restrained darker pigment near select edges, hand-painted wood grain. Preserve recognizable walnut/oak material identity. Keep sharp-enough foreground notebook and pencil, readable silhouettes and doorway boundaries. No global fog, no overexposed whites, no muddy blur, no vibrating noisy texture, no all-over black outlines, no glossy plastic or photorealistic game render.
Mood/color: gentle warm cream plaster, rich cocoa and honey wood, muted olive linen, warm ivory-to-mocha matte stone flooring, luminous soft amber lamplight with broad feathered shadows. Calm intimate personal writing sanctuary after work. Adequately lit notebook and walkways; avoid darkness.
Composition: landscape presentation board approximately 3:2. Upper roughly 70 percent is ONE spacious first-person interior view closely based on the reference layout, with soft watercolor materials and rounded objects. Lower roughly 30 percent is THREE clean side-by-side detail studies from this exact same space separated by narrow ivory gutters: (1) a rounded ceramic cup, notebook with paper fibers and wooden pencil resting on the central wood table; (2) rounded chair back, mitered wood frame and warm pendant lamp materials; (3) a modest planted garden with small flowers, one tree and a shallow pond with three tiny goldfish, seen through the same broad wood-framed doorway. No forest or dense jungle.
Typography: only a small restrained title at the top "수채화 속 필사 카페" and three small Korean labels under the detail studies exactly "잔과 종이", "원목과 조명", "정원과 연못". The wall cafe sign can read "쓰는 인간". Do not reproduce the old app HUD, floating selection label, brush icon or other interface controls. No new functions, shops, price tags, characters or watermarks. Original aesthetic, no named-artist imitation. Make the entire space visibly watercolor-inspired while still a dimensional place someone could walk into.
scope: Concept board only. Material textures, meshes, shaders, picking, persistence and deployment have not changed. The watercolor request is retained as a future cafe art-direction rule; exact treatment awaits review.
